notes: Reference date 2018-02-25. 2018_13 (short-term disability HR page) is not among the usable sources.

Governing documents: Paid Parental Leave policy VI.E.3 (rev. 2017-01-01) covers benefits-eligible faculty; Executive Memorandum C-46 (1999) governs faculty sick leave, vacation, personal business days and unpaid personal leave; FMLA policy VI.E.1 (rev. 2018-01-01); Procedures for Granting Academic Tenure and Promotion (eff. 2017-04-19) supplementing I.B.2 govern tenure-clock extensions. The HR benefits pages (2018_06, 2018_07) are summaries; the Engineering pages (2018_04, 2018_05) are a college site. 2018_10 is an index page holding no policy.

U1 Purdue example: C-46's unpaid personal leave replaced the former newborn infant care leave; its current purpose (any reason) governs, so it is c7, general_purpose, and the old newborn-care leave is not a component.

Sick leave (C-46) is an employer allowance by service band restored over a rolling 12-month period (R1 employer plan). U8: the 2-3 year band is coded (44 workdays at 100% then 44 at 75%); the 3+ year band (66 + 66) is in duration_max. Under one year: 10 workdays at 100%; 1-2 years: 22 + 22. Coded as pay alone (U6), with an ambiguous flag because C-46 gives sick leave its own reinstatement clause.

Vacation: academic-year faculty (the standard appointment) accrue no paid vacation and are on unpaid vacation when classes are not in session; c8 is recorded for fiscal-year faculty and staff by name (schema §2b).

Tenure clock: the 2017 Procedures (2018_11) govern; the November 2015 Provost form (2018_12) and the College of Engineering copy of the same guidelines (2018_04) add a requirement to request within one year of the birth or adoption (conflicting_sources on c9). The Engineering page reproduces the university policy (it cites B-48 and the Provost), so it is cited on the university components rather than coded as a separate college provision.

B-48 section II (2018_09), including 'Official leave without salary ... will not count toward the limits of probationary time', was superseded by I.B.2 from 2016-01-01 (header of 2018_09 and I.B.2 history); not coded as in force. The 2017 Procedures carry the part-time extension (c11).
VI.E.2 Maximum Leave: total continuous leaves of absence may not exceed one calendar year, FMLA leave not counted; recorded in leave_limits (52 weeks on c1 and c7).

Short- and long-term disability are named (VI.E.3 coordination clause; VI.E.2 military-leave benefits; HR menu) but their terms are not in any usable source (the STD page is not among the usable sources; no LTD page saved). Not coded; flagged cross_reference_not_saved on c1.

Calendar: the documents state semesters ('fall semester', 'spring semester', 'the first day of classes each semester') but no length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in terms.

Cross-references not saved: Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability pages (HR); Paid Parental Leave Knowledge Base / PPL process; Child Care and Lactation Support Program; Leave of Absence & Disability Information (Business @ Purdue); 29 C.F.R. Part 825; Executive Memoranda C-45 (clerical and service staff) and C-47 (superseded); Terms and Conditions of Employment of Faculty Members (B-50); Sabbatical Leave of Absence (B-11); Employment Period for Academic-Year Staff (C-26); University Policy VI.10.2 Leave of Absence (Provost index link); West Lafayette Criteria for Tenure and Promotion; Request for Probationary Period Extension form (2017 version); Faculty Grievances (I.B.1); department personal-business-day guidelines.

Birth parent chain: Paid Parental Leave 240 hours (6 weeks, 100%) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c2 concurrent_with c1); sick pay 44 workdays at 100% within FMLA (c3 within c2), then 44 workdays at 75% (c4 consecutive_after c3).

Non-birth parent chain: Paid Parental Leave 240 hours (6 weeks) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c2 concurrent_with c1); family-care sick pay up to 10 workdays within FMLA (c5 within c2).

Not components: military, jury and witness duty, bereavement and worker's compensation leaves (VI.E.2) cannot be used for a birth; outside activities leave (C-46); the FMLA temporary transfer during intermittent leave (an FMLA administrative measure, not a pregnancy accommodation).
